audits.text:
## f20defd6ea3c

**Reproduced defects.** Audited source SHA
`f9c3ced895d58a1f478870a885aca87f84a713d85953fb6287613e9c577cf42f`
(version 2.2.0). Four advertised controls are operationally inert in an exact
same-seed comparison: `palette_kind=warm|cool`, `palette_size=1|9`,
`n_distinct_colors=1|9`, and helpful `texture=default|cool` each return
byte-identical grids. An unknown override key is silently accepted. Advertised
valid values are also band-restricted without declaration: examples include
`n_seeds=5` rejected in easy, `n_seeds=1` rejected in medium, `grid_h=3`
rejected in hard, and `grid_w=4` rejected in hard. Exact requests and outputs are
in `checks/audits/f20defd6ea3c/probe.json`.

The public compact override stage independently failed with 18,138 findings,
including accepted unknown keys, missing exact-axis provenance, singleton axes,
and undeclared band incompatibilities. A concise extract is retained at
`checks/audits/f20defd6ea3c/override-summary.json`; console evidence is
`checks/audits/f20defd6ea3c/override-after-console.log`.

**Canonical validator defect.** `self_check(..., difficulty=None)` requires 2–3
seeds, but canonical train pair 0 has one seed and is rejected with
`expected 2..3 seed cells for difficulty=None, got 1`. The other three labeled
canonical pairs pass. This makes canonical acceptance depend on a sampler count
policy rather than the underlying rule.

**Domain question / possible shortcut.** Ordinary draws force distinct colors
and distinct down-right diagonals, excluding the authority's same-diagonal
interaction branch and repeated-color unions. That may be an intentional narrow
domain—the source calls same-diagonal inputs degenerate—but the summary states
“each seed” without explaining that branch exclusion. A lesson can therefore
support a shortcut that assumes rays never encounter another seed. Before
broadening, obtain Racket-labelled same-diagonal cases and document overwrite
semantics; otherwise state the restriction prominently and remove controls that
pretend to cover it. No audit-target files were changed.
